changes: From World 2 every stage needs a little Power to start: 70% of what it is made for in World 2, 80% in World 3 and 85% in Worlds 4 and 5. START RACE and STAGES show how much you need, so you are never stuck at a jump your car can't make
From World 3, flips and wheelies add 1 s each (Worlds 1-2 keep +2 s, +3 s for a backflip): on the later stages a better car matters more than stunts
Worlds 4 and 5: a stage starts only when your car has at least 85% of the Power it is made for (Stage 50 needs Power 77). START RACE shows how much you need: upgrade to race
New leaderboards: every stage has a new, empty board for the new driving, so your first finish puts you on top. Your coins, cars, parts and stars all stay
Pick your racer name when the game starts. Every name is unique: nobody can take a name another racer already has, on any stage
Names use 3-16 letters, numbers, _ or -. Emojis, symbols and rude words aren't allowed, and extra spaces are tidied up
Part cards: every level square lights the same yellow (Levels 11 to 15 used to light orange)

Crash damage: landing on the roof, the nose or the tail costs your car health and slows it down, up to 30% slower, until the finish. The health bar, scratches, dents, smoke and sparks show how bad it is. Look after your car: land on your wheels!
Crash too often and your car is wrecked: the race stops. Once a race you can watch an ad to repair it to 50% and carry on
Every car now shows its damage: it looks battered below 70% health and wrecked below 35%, drawn for each car, and your TUNE paint stays on
Crushers: after a squash only the press that got you waits until you're past its row; the others keep crushing
PERFECT LANDING! no longer pops up after a crash or after being put back on the road

More things damage your car: a wrecking ball 10%, falling into a pit 5%, driving head-on into a wall or ledge 3-8%, hard bumps under the car 1-3% (more often with the car lowered in TUNE). Half in Worlds 1-2
Engine: every level from 8 to 15 now adds the same speed, so the top levels count. Your car keeps its top speed: your Engine level went up to match
Gearbox: from Level 2 it also drives the front wheel, and every level adds acceleration (a full upgrade gets to top speed in 1.4 s)
Suspension: hard landings cost speed, up to 20% at Level 1 and only 5% at Level 10
TUNE: the speed side of gearing and grip gives less top speed (2% and 1%), so every setting is a real trade
Clocks re-timed for the new cars; a little less time on 7 stages with low bridges, a little more on Stages 42, 49 and 50
Join the Garage Rush Discord: tap the Discord icon at the bottom left of the garage
The messages under the timer have a thick black border, easier to read on bright skies
Flips count only when you land on your wheels: a crash that rolls over pays nothing
Frame also makes your car tougher: Level 10 halves crash damage
Crushers and wrecking balls cost time when they get you (2 s in Worlds 1-2, 3-4 s after)
Time's up shows how far you were from the next checkpoint, with a driving tip. Out of time just short? RETRY costs no fuel
NEXT tells you when your car is short of the Power the next stage is made for
The x2 COINS button is now "Watch an ad. Get extra coins.": it pays this race's coins and distance again (first-finish and star bonuses are paid once)
A little more time on 13 stages of Worlds 1-2; one wheelie bonus between two checkpoints

STAGES: tap the stage name (or the world name) in the garage to see every world and its stages at once, each on its own sky, with your stars, the Power it needs, your place on its leaderboard and your best time. Tap a stage to pick it
Worlds 6 to 10 are on their way: you can see them in STAGES as COMING SOON
The game is lighter on your phone: its pictures take far less memory and a smaller download, with the same look
Credits: the music is the Racing Music Pack by Fan Zoo
New engine sounds: every car has its own recorded engine. The revs rise smoothly, hold steady at top speed, fall when you let go, and the engine goes quiet in the air
TUNE, LOOK: pick Car's own, Rotary, Inline six or Retro for each car. The Rotary no longer keeps revving at top speed
New stunt: WHEELIE! Ride on your rear wheels (or your front wheels) for 1.5 s for +2 s
Pedal lights: the brake glows red, and the gas charges up from green to yellow while you hold it
Leaderboards: finishes after a CONTINUE now count too, and times that never reached the leaderboard (no internet) are sent again
New music: a new garage theme and a new race track
New coin sound and a finish-line fanfare
Potholes look like real holes: the road edge dips into them
Obstacles are easier to see: a dark outline and a shadow on the road, and sand, puddles, oil, mud, ice and lava-glass get a bright edge
Wider part cards with bigger UPGRADE buttons: tapping near one upgrades instead of opening the part's info
This box is now big and easy to read
Checkpoints are calmer: a small green glow instead of a big flash
The update button in this box is always here: it shows UPDATE when a new version is out, or says you have the latest one
The race help (?) keeps the ?, pause and RESET buttons on screen with a ? on each, from the very first race, and now explains the progress bar too
FRAME now makes your car spin faster in the air, so more flips fit into one jump. Flips still pay +2 s (front) and +3 s (backflip)
A car on its roof is put back on its wheels after 1.5 s, the same for every car, even while it still slides a little
This box: what changed in each update, and an UPDATE button when a newer version is out. Tap the version number at the bottom to open it again
Coin rewards lowered in every world: upgrades now take more racing
Air vents lift the car every time, even when you roll onto them slowly or in reverse
Backflips now give +3 s, front flips +2 s
New progress bar under the timer: start, checkpoints, finish and where you are
Tap any part (or its yellow ?) to see what it does
TUNE has two pages: LOOK (paint, engine sound) and DRIVE (ride height, gearing, grip)
Pick an engine sound for each car in TUNE, LOOK
"No ad right now" text fits inside its button
